title: 第11章 危机第12章 剑法
slug: 修仙所有人都以为她背景很强
lines: “叶师姐，这里就是东初山脉么？”
巫未央四处张望，入目之处皆是绿意葱葱。
这里灵气比朝天宗山头的还要浓郁一点，巫未央一来到这里就感觉格外舒服。
叶葵收了法器又拿出一枚玉简，口中回答道，“是啊是啊。”
答完，她又冲着玉简喊道，“赵天辰，你们在哪里？”
巫未央被她的举动吸引，好奇地望着她...手中的玉简。
叶葵的话音落下不久之后，玉简亮了亮，赵天辰的声音传出，“我们在小潭附近。”
叶葵显然对东初山脉很熟悉，听完赵天辰的报点后就领着巫未央直奔目的地。
巫未央一边倒腾着小腿跟在她身后，一边问道，“叶师姐，你手里的是什么？”
叶葵举起玉简，“这个吗，是传讯玉简，若你以后修为高了，也是要买一个来用的。”
简而言之，这不是她这个炼气一层小修士能玩的。
巫未央得到答案后也不再发话。
两人很快到了赵天辰所说的小潭边，她们扫视一圈，果然看到小潭边上有块天然的大石头，有几道身影正在石头上。
叶葵再次掏出莲花法器，抱住巫未央飞了上去。
“唐师兄。”
巫未央率先开口问候。
唐落天看到她却是立刻皱眉，“怎么把小师妹带来了。”
巫未央站在原地，不知所措。
叶葵说道，“东初山脉外围妖兽又不多，有也是炼气期，我是看我们都在这，小师妹却一个人在山上呆着，多孤单。”
她已经听说师兄师姐们好几天不回山上，小师妹才七岁一个人留在那里实在不妥。
唐落天表情舒缓了些，对巫未央说道，“这几日我们的确是忽略了你，不过这里随时有妖兽出现，你要时时警惕，一遇到危险就躲在我们身后。”
巫未央不是不识好歹的人，唐师兄几人明显是为了前程在拼搏，叶师姐也只是担心她一个人。
她乖巧点头，“我记住了。”
唐落天见她听话，就让她呆一边玩去了，自己则提剑跃下巨石，“前面有一群食草猪，小师妹来了正好，我去杀两头给你改善下伙食。”
巫未央不知道食草猪是什么猪，想来和村里豢养的猪差不了多少，想起猪肉的美味，她眼睛亮了亮，“谢谢师兄。”
柳苗苗则嘱咐，“再摘点灵果，配着烤猪肉好吃。”
唐落天颔首，御剑而去。
他是炼气大圆满修为，已经接近筑基，所以体内灵气已经足以他短程御剑。
唐落天走后，柳苗苗直接从储物袋里拿出锅碗瓢盆在小潭边洗刷起来。
赵天辰和崔景则一个垒灶，一个捡柴火。
叶葵拉住蠢蠢欲动想要帮忙的巫未央，“你就交给他们忙活去吧。”
虽然她这样说，但巫未央还是凑到柳苗苗身边替她洗刷了。
叶葵摇摇头，她就没见过这么勤快的小孩，她自己七八岁的时候，有别人照顾她是一点不想忙活的。
小潭清澈见底，巫未央伸手搅动，一圈圈涟漪散开，温凉的水让她感到格外舒服。
content_en:
"Senior Sister Ye, is this the Dongchu Mountain Range?"
Wu Weiyang looked around and saw greenery everywhere.
The spiritual energy here is a bit richer than that at the top of Chaotian Sect's mountain. Wu Weiyang felt particularly comfortable as soon as he came here.
Ye Kui put away the magic weapon and took out a jade slip, and replied, "Yes, yes."
After answering, she shouted to the jade slip again, "Zhao Tianchen, where are you?"
Wu Weiyang was attracted by her actions and looked curiously at the jade slip in her hand.
Not long after Ye Kui finished speaking, the jade slip lit up, and Zhao Tianchen's voice came out, "We are near Xiaotan."
Ye Kui was obviously very familiar with the Dongchu Mountains. After listening to Zhao Tianchen's report, he led Wu Weiyang straight to the destination.
Wu Weiyang followed her with her calves in the air and asked, "Senior Sister Ye, what's in your hand?"
Ye Kui raised the jade slip and said, "This is the jade slip for communication. If you become more advanced in the future, you will also need to buy one for use."
In short, this is not something she, a young monk at the first level of Qi refining, can do.
Wu Weiyang stopped talking after getting the answer.
The two of them soon arrived at the small pool that Zhao Tianchen had mentioned. They glanced around and saw a large natural stone on the edge of the small pool, with several figures standing on the stone.
Ye Kui took out the lotus magic weapon again, hugged Wu Weiyang and flew up.
"Senior Brother Tang."
Wu Weiyang was the first to greet him.
Tang Luotian frowned immediately when he saw her, "Why did you bring the junior sister here?"
Wu Weiyang stood there, at a loss.
Ye Kui said, "There are not many monsters outside the Dongchu Mountain Range, and it is the Qi refining period. I think we are all here, but the junior sister is alone in the mountain, how lonely it is."
She had already heard that her brothers and sisters had not returned to the mountain for several days. It was not appropriate for the little sister to stay there alone when she was only seven years old.
Tang Luotian's expression softened a little and he said to Wu Weiyang, "We have indeed ignored you these past few days, but there are monsters appearing here at any time. You must always be vigilant and hide behind us if you encounter danger."
Wu Weiyang is not a ungrateful person. Senior Brother Tang and others are obviously working hard for their future, and Senior Sister Ye is only worried about her.
She nodded obediently, "I remember."
Tang Luotian saw that she was obedient, so he let her stay and play, while he jumped off the boulder with his sword in hand, "There is a group of grass-eating pigs in front of us. Junior sister is here just in time. I will kill two of them to improve your food."
Wu Weiyang didn't know what kind of pigs were grass-eating pigs, but she thought they were similar to the pigs raised in the village. Thinking of the deliciousness of pork, her eyes lit up, "Thank you, senior brother."
Liu Miaomiao asked, "Pick some more spiritual fruits and it will be delicious with roast pork."
Tang Luotian nodded and left with his sword.
He has attained the Great Perfection of Qi Refining and is close to establishing the foundation, so the spiritual energy in his body is enough for him to wield a sword in a short range.
After Tang Luotian left, Liu Miaomiao took out the pots and pans from her storage bag and started washing them by the small pool.
Zhao Tianchen and Cui Jingze were building a stove and collecting firewood.
Ye Kui grabbed Wu Weiyang who was about to help, "Just leave it to them."
Although she said this, Wu Weiyang still came to Liu Miaomiao to clean her up.
Ye Kui shook her head. She had never seen such a diligent child. When she was seven or eight years old, she didn't want to be busy at all when someone else took care of her.
The small pool was crystal clear. Wu Weiyang stretched out her hand to stir, and the ripples spread out. The warm and cool water made her feel particularly comfortable.
